title: Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instability that serves as a reliability signal. Building on these findings, we introduce a test-time aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength. translated_title: 多智能体聚合中的偏差控制与注入
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体推理提出了集体决策中的一个核心问题：当智能体之间意见不一致时，应该信任谁的决策？解决这类分歧非常困难，因为智能体的决策容易受到非语义偏差的影响，例如多数压力和回答风格偏好，这些偏差会掩盖底层推理的真实质量。我们的分析展示了偏差既能被缓解又能被利用：偏差控制可以改善初始答案的选择，而偏差注入可以引发决策不稳定性，这种不稳定性可作为可靠性信号。基于这些发现，我们提出了一个测试时聚合框架，该框架既不需要验证数据，也不需要关于模型相对强度的先验知识。该框架通过为每个不同的答案呈现一条风格归一化的推理轨迹来实现偏差控制，并通过将每个聚合智能体最初选择的答案放置在……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个无需验证数据和模型强度先验知识的测试时多智能体聚合框架，通过偏差控制改善初始答案选择，并利用偏差注入引发的决策不稳定性作为可靠性信号来判断应信任哪个智能体的决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a test-time multi-agent aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength, improving initial answer selection through bias control and leveraging decision instability elicited by bias injection as a reliability signal.
